mostWorthwhile.text: Forming a moon from the impact debris was most worthwhile: it connected the collision to a lasting change around the same world.

leastWorthwhile.text: The later fragment sequence felt repetitive, with several successive encounters involving rubble and debris.

surprise.text: I expected the crossing rocky body to transfer material, but it broke the coated rubble apart again.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the successive debris combinations were hard to distinguish in advance and I followed the only offered action.

continue.text: Probably not immediately: the moon formation was engaging, but the later sequence felt repetitive and offered few meaningful choices.
